Command: Levites shall carry the ark on their shoulders
Summary: The command: Levites shall carry the ark on their shoulders (Numbers 7:9). The sons of Kohath bore the ark and the holy vessels on their shoulders, not on a cart, when the camp set forward.
Commandment: Levites shall carry the ark on their shoulders, as prescribed in Numbers 7:9.
Application: It cannot be practised as written without the standing temple and Aaronic priesthood; its enduring lesson is God's holiness, the cost of atonement, and worship offered exactly as God appoints.
Purpose: TRADITIONAL reading: the ark, the throne of God's presence, was borne by consecrated hands on shoulders, not hauled as common freight.
